name: plan-progress
description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, a pixel fill and soft sounds for decision, error and done

doneBarSeconds.title: Finished bar stays (seconds)
doneBarSeconds.description: Seconds a finished bar stays above the prompt while /plan-progress-autoclose is on

twinkle.title: Twinkle the pixel fill
twinkle.description: Animate the dots of the progress fill and of the agent rows. Off, they are drawn still; clocks, glides and status dots still move

hideAgentRows.title: Hide Claude Code's rows of the agents the bars show
hideAgentRows.description: Terminal only. On, the mod adds subagentStatusLine to your Claude Code settings.json (unless you set one), and Claude Code's own agent list under the prompt leaves out the agents a bar's strips show. Off, the mod takes that line out again
